name: Elixir
description: Elixir is a functional, concurrent language built on the Erlang VM (BEAM). It excels at building fault-tolerant, distributed systems with the Phoenix web framework and LiveView for real-time apps. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Elixir School
items.description: The unofficial community guide with lessons from basic syntax to advanced topics like Ecto, Phoenix, OTP, and LiveView. Translated in 25+ languages.

items.title: Learn Elixir (dwyl GitHub)
items.description: An open-source bootcamp-style repository teaching why Elixir matters, setup, syntax, and building production web apps.

items.title: Elixir Getting Started Guide
items.description: The definitive introduction by language creators covering syntax, pattern matching, mix, and OTP.

items.title: Elixir Official Learning Page
items.description: The centralized portal listing approved community books, courses, screencasts, and learning pathways.

items.title: HexDocs — Elixir Standard Library
items.description: Complete API documentation for the Elixir standard library with detailed module references.

items.title: Exercism — Elixir Track
items.description: 58 concepts and 168 exercises with community mentoring for writing idiomatic Elixir.

items.title: Learn Elixir with Livebook
items.description: Hands-on guide using Livebook, Elixirs interactive notebook ecosystem, for interactive learning.

items.title: Elixir & Phoenix Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A comprehensive video course covering Elixir fundamentals through building real applications with Phoenix.

items.title: ElixirConf Talks (YouTube)
items.description: Conference talks from Elixir core contributors and industry leaders on distributed systems and LiveView.

items.title: Exercism — Elixir Track
items.description: 100% free coding exercises with community mentoring and automated analysis.

items.title: Codewars — Elixir Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges in Elixir across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: Elixir Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise one-page reference covering Elixir syntax, types, pipes, and pattern matching.

items.title: Elixir ExDoc Cheatsheets
items.description: Integrated cheat sheet features across Elixir library documentation for quick function lookups.

items.title: Elixir Radar Newsletter
items.description: Weekly curated newsletter with ecosystem news, community packages, tutorials, and job opportunities.

items.title: Elixir Lang Blog
items.description: Official blog with release announcements, community stories, and language evolution updates.

items.title: Elixir Forum
items.description: The official community forum with Q&A, Phoenix/LiveView release notes, and event discussions.

items.title: Reddit r/elixir
items.description: Active community for career questions, blog posts, code reviews, and ecosystem trend discussions.

items.title: Elixir Slack
items.description: Real-time chat with dedicated channels for beginners, Phoenix, and OTP.

lessons.description: Core concepts, syntax, and first steps with Elixir
